name: Claine de Lune
source:
Faction:	        Terran
Birthday:	        December 14, 2387
Place of Birth:	St. Niliam, Lagrange 2
Occupation:	Ensign, CIC Officer
Affiliation:	        United Terran Vanguard

Profile:
Ensign Claine de Lune is a graduate of the Lunar Military Academy at Mondshire, and was assigned to the Sierra as CIC officer when it was launched.

She is patient, smart, adaptable and very well-organized with battle data files, careful to do her best to make life easier for the Captain in planning missions. A young woman dedicated to doing her duty, Claine quietly takes pride in a job well done.

Despite her determination and cheery disposition, a dark cloud seems to hang over her.
translation:
阵营：地球人
生日：2387年12月14日
出生地：圣尼利亚姆，拉格朗日2点
职业：少尉、作战情报中心军官
所属：联合地球先锋队

简介：
克莱恩·德·卢恩少尉毕业于蒙德郡月球军事学院，塞拉号下水时被任命为作战情报中心军官。

她耐心、聪明、适应力强，战斗数据文件整理得井井有条，总是竭尽全力让舰长更容易规划任务。她是个忠于职守的年轻女性，悄悄为出色完成工作感到自豪。

尽管她意志坚定、性格开朗，却似乎始终笼罩着一片阴云。
